structured_output.what_is_happening: A copycat "Kardashev Research" token, apparently riding a Beff Jezos (beffjezos) X post. The packet lists at least 8 other same-name KARDASHEV clones launched within about 45 minutes. The earliest one (5wW9…, created about 40 minutes before this pair) is at $1.3M market cap and looks like the leading version. This one (6mzE…) is a non-pump.fun mint with a pool the creator seeded directly on PumpSwap. The pool's LP is 100% unlocked, and liquidity ($30k) is larger than market cap ($21k). It went up about 100% in its first 15 minutes on roughly $290k of volume, and was already down 16–31% over the last 5 minutes when detected.

narrative.description: Kardashev scale / 'Kardashev Research', tied to a Beff Jezos (e/acc) tweet. This is a real attention catalyst, and the leading token has reached $1.3M.
narrative.why_spreading: A known e/acc figure posted about it. The flood of same-name launches shows traders are farming the attention, but it is going to the first version and the highest-volume clones, not this one.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the shared name and ticker, plus GeckoTerminal linking the same Beff Jezos tweet. Nothing shows this is the version the tweet endorsed. It was launched about 40 minutes after the leader.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 5wW9… ($1.3M mcap, earliest, likely the leading version); 9jpU… ($3.0M h1 volume); AAye… ($1.6M h1 volume); GiSE…, 8yoK… and several more with the same name.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 47 bundler wallets holding about 25.6% (top bundler trader share). There are 674 unique buyers but only 55 unique sellers, which fits bot or distributed-wallet buying. The creator has launched 7 tokens and has already closed their position (creator_close). This looks like a clone-farm pattern: deploy many same-name tokens and seed their liquidity yourself.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X or Telegram visibility. Some of the buyers could be real traders chasing the tweet who can't tell the clones apart.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked, held by the creator, who can pull it at any time
Liquidity larger than market cap, which fits a creator-seeded pool set up to be pulled
Serial deployer (7 tokens), creator already closed position
Clone of a name whose leading version already exists; about 8 competing copies
Price down 16–31% over the last 5 minutes at detection

structured_output.counterargument: The Beff Jezos catalyst is real, and clone copies sometimes get 2–3x swings when the leader pumps and overflow buyers pile into cheap copies. At $21k market cap, a 2x only needs about $20k of net buying. With 674 unique buyers in 15 minutes, one more wave of spillover could reach +100% before the creator pulls liquidity.
unknowns: Which token Beff Jezos actually endorsed, if any
Whether the creator will pull the unlocked LP, and when
Whether the unique-buyer count is real traders or bundled wallets
Whether the leading version keeps pumping and spills over to clones

source_coverage.notes: No internet in this condition; judged from the packet only.

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a clone-farm copy of a real tweet-driven narrative. It is not the first or leading version, its LP is fully unlocked and seeded by the creator, it has heavy bundling, the creator is a serial deployer who has already closed out, and momentum was already fading at detection. Rug risk is high and the chance of hitting 2x is small. It should rank near the bottom.
